checks.label: Duplicate payment verification
checks.detail: No high-confidence duplicates after filtering 2983 batch payments and 0 CSV overlaps. Previous false positives eliminated.

checks.label: Split payment analysis
checks.detail: 2463 suspect instances (£616.7M, 12.7% of spend). Threshold: 5+ payments to same supplier in same week, 80%+ of approval limit.

checks.label: Year-end spike verification
checks.detail: Highest spike: 3.3x in Highways & Transport Services. Year-end spikes are common in public sector (capital programmes, grants). Only extreme spikes (>3x) warrant concern.

checks.label: CH compliance — pre-breach only
checks.detail: 3 suppliers have current breaches, but all payments were made before breaches started. Not violations at time of payment.

checks.label: Benford's Law forensic screening
checks.detail: Significant deviation from Benford's Law (p < 0.001). χ²=86066.75 on 872770 amounts >£100. Largest deviation: digit 5 (6.5% off expected).
